message.content: Starting the hunt with broad random sweeps at boundary extremes.
Found a wall penetration — now shrinking it to the minimal failing case.
Shrunk to a fast body hitting a wall — confirming the failure and inspecting the impact.
Replay confirms the violation — checking the steps before impact to pin down the cause.
I see a high-speed bounce that leaves the body embedded in the wall — testing whether a smaller timestep removes it.
